hook: On average, Saturn is less dense than water, so in a thought experiment it would float, but real Saturn is gas and would not stay in one piece.

chatgptPrompt:
Create a YouTube Shorts / TikTok cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Keep the focal point and the text inside the centre safe area: clear of the bottom 25% and of the right-hand button column.
Subject: Saturn with level rings sitting half-sunk in a huge transparent tank of water, the waterline crossing the planet (an illustration, a thought experiment).
Composition: tank centred in the upper two thirds, Saturn at the waterline, empty indigo night around; all in the centre safe area.
Lighting and treatment: warm pale-gold planet, teal (#4FE3C6) water glow, indigo night (#0B0F2A), soft rim light, subtle grain.
Mood: wonder with a hint of doubt.
Text: "Not quite." in a clean geometric sans (Lexend style), centred in the lower middle, white with the last word teal (#4FE3C6).
Scientific accuracy: Saturn's average density, about 0.69 g/cm3, is lower than water's 1.0, so it would float in a thought-experiment bathtub; real Saturn is mostly hydrogen and helium gas and would mix with water, not stay in one piece.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news or NASA photo. It must read as a code-rendered illustration in the channel's look (indigo night #0B0F2A, teal #4FE3C6 light fronts, violet #5B3FD0).
Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
